descFull: Opensource, on-device voice + vision layer for AI agents. Bring any model or coding agent; the whole speech loop (VAD, STT, TTS, barge-in) runs locally. An open alternative to ElevenLabs Agents, Gemini Live, and OpenAI Realtime.
